timeline.summary: Archie sets off across the desert in a carriage with two Sterling guards, expecting bandits.
timeline.quote: His employer would never have provided two Sterling Company guards unless the job carried risks.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A wall of fire stops the carriage and the Hellspurs kill the Sterling guards.
timeline.quote: Nearly a dozen holes appeared across the side of the carriage, and the Sterling guards fell immediately.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul splits the carriage, takes the sack and declares the last key his, but finds only coal and flies into a rage.
timeline.quote: "Finally. The last key is mine."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Archie dies in the burning sand while the real key gets farther away from Akul.
timeline.quote: For all he cared about punctuality, he never expected to be so early to his own death.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie Flash follows the smoke on Fortune, recognises Akul's work in the burned carriage and finds an untouched lockbox of cash.
timeline.quote: A lockbox sat inside, untouched.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie deduces that the Hellspurs left the money because they were after something bigger.
timeline.quote: But they left the money behind—which meant they were after something else.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Yuma arrives in Omenport a year ago with the money sewn into his suit, walks into the desert and nearly dies of heat exhaustion.
timeline.quote: Heat exhaustion comes up on you unawares is what I've learned since then.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Yuma meets the baby cactusfolk Kirri, who leads him to a dry riverbed and saves his life.
timeline.quote: Low ground turned out to be a dry riverbed, cool water under the sand. So, I lived.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi recalls the day the Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo, after she was compleated.
timeline.quote: his mind was transported back to the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi practices story magic in the cactus forest with the memory of his mother, but falters when grief breaks his focus.
timeline.quote: Nashi faltered, and the sprout gave a weakened shudder before coiling back into the sand.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi relives a memory in which young Nashi, with a homemade bird gadget, is told by Tamiyo not to hide who he is.
timeline.quote: You are Nashi . That is who I'm proud of.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi realizes he is not so different from his mother, and finds his magic flows naturally when he loads recordings onto drones.
timeline.quote: Magic bristled at his fingertips, more naturally than ever before.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Long Way from Home" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises a griffin-manticore from the ground and Geralf borrows a jackalope, and the siblings ride for Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: the two of them were off, riding across the wide-open plains of Thunder Junction toward their distant, unpleasant destination.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The siblings camp at night and Geralf observes that Gisa's zombies are not weakening, testing his planar theory.
timeline.quote: Her wellspring of Innistrad energy had yet to run dry.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf wakes Gisa, who fell asleep on watch, and they set off for Thief's Folly with her zombie animals following.
timeline.quote: They rode off into the dawn, Gisa's mismatched zombie army hopping, scurrying, and slithering after them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Nine years earlier, young Jace is sent by Tezzeret to the Fomori vault and senses a childlike mind within.
timeline.quote: he feels a mind deep within the vault, sleepy with torpor, childlike and quiet.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reunite with the prize, a toddler-like child from the Fomori vault.
timeline.quote: The boy (Tamiyo's text said it was a boy) seems all too happy to take in the world around them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the child's mind and learns his name is Loot.
timeline.quote: "His name is Loot."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace sees that Loot's mind holds a map of the entire Multiverse and every Omenpath endpoint.
timeline.quote: It's the way to get from every point to every point.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska promise to protect Loot as their ward.
timeline.quote: Vraska and I will protect you with all of our strength.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: The three plan to walk through an Omenpath into the Multiverse, resolved that theirs will be better.
timeline.quote: Ours will be better.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.
